name: Scenario presets advanced assumptions and history
description: Verify read-only scenario creation, comparison, history, optimization, and deletion.

planSteps.description: The page states scenarios do not change source records and shows quick scenarios, advanced assumptions, history, and optimization candidates
Run the quick scenario Gelir %10 down or the equivalent visible revenue-decrease preset
A scenario result page opens with final delta, first negative month, worst balance or maximum gap, assumptions, insights, comparison chart, and monthly comparison
Return to scenarios and create an advanced scenario named TESTSPRITE TEMP SCENARIO with a small expense increase and debt service included
The advanced scenario is saved and appears in scenario history
Open TESTSPRITE TEMP SCENARIO and delete it using the safe delete control
Only that scenario disappears from history and the baseline cash-flow workspace still loads
